findings.detail: The numeric cost 39,626 (represented as 39.66 in the flag) was used as exposure_type instead of the row label Specialty Retail.

rationale: Raw source table 28 row 23 identifies the exposure category as Specialty Retail and separately reports March 31, 2026 cost of 39,626, fair value of 39,811, and 3.2%. The flagged metric 39.66 matches the scaled cost, so a numeric amount was mapped into the categorical exposure_type field.
